# v2.62-dev Release Notes

## Fixed: double-counted gaps in Compliance Planning when a certification is shared across specialisations

On **Programs › Compliance Planning**, when the same certification satisfies more
than one specialisation you selected, the plan double-counted it. In the "Who to
certify" drill-down a person could show the **same gap twice** (an inflated "Gaps
closed"), and — less visibly — each shared gap's fill was counted twice, which made
the plan **under-count net-new** and **nominate fewer candidates than the gap
actually needs**.

The candidate allocator now credits each person to a given requirement **at most
once**, so:

- a person's expanded detail lists each gap they close only once, and "Gaps closed"
  is accurate;
- "People to certify", "Net-new training", and the "Who to certify" list correctly
  reflect the real number of people needed for a certification shared across
  specialisations.

If you plan against a certification that several specialisations require, expect the
headline figures to move — they were under-counting before and are now correct.
